title: A pilot TriAl of psilocybiN-Assisted psychotherapy for the treatment Of Sex addiction
official: A pilot TriAl of psilocybiN-Assisted psychotherapy for the treatment Of Sex addiction
summary: Main objective: To assess the feasibility of conducting a randomized clinical trial of PAP for the treatment of AS, by estimating the ability to retain participants through the end of the protocol
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men and women aged 18 or over
2. Negative result in the urine toxicology screening
3. If taking psychotropic medication (excluding nicotine replacement therapy): the dose has been stabilised or treatment has been underway for more than one month
4. In whom a current diagnosis of sex addiction has been confirmed (Carnes diagnostic criteria)
5. Able to complete self-assessment questionnaires
6. Agreeing to a blood test and an electrocardiogram
7. Written and oral comprehension of French
8. Having signed an informed consent form prior to any study procedure
9. Affiliated with a French social security system
10. Women of childbearing age with a negative pregnancy test and using highly effective contraception (in accordance with version 1.2 of the Clinical Trials Coordination Group (CTCG) guidelines dated March 2024)
11. Men of reproductive age using effective contraception (in accordance with version 1.2 of the CTCG guidelines dated March 2024)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Severe cognitive impairment (Mini-Mental State Examination score < 26)
2. High current risk of suicide (according to the MINI 5.0 suicide risk module)
3. History of hallucinogen use disorder or any use in the past year
4. Current alcohol use disorder with a history of withdrawal symptoms
5. Extreme underweight (BMI < 16.5) or obesity (BMI > 30)
6. Epilepsy
7. Liver failure or significant hepatocellular damage, defined by at least one of the following criteria: TP < 50 per cent; ASAT and/or ALAT > 5 times the upper limit of normal (ULN); ASAT or ALAT > 3 times the ULN with total bilirubin > 2 times the ULN; or ASAT or ALAT > 3 times the ULN associated with signs or symptoms suggestive of liver damage (fatigue, nausea, vomiting, pain or tenderness in the right upper quadrant, fever, skin rash) and/or eosinophilia.
8. Significantly impaired renal function (eGFR < 90 mL/min)
9. Coronary heart disease
10. History of arrhythmia
11. Heart failure
12. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to psilocybin or to any of the excipients contained in the investigational medicinal product
13. Uncontrolled high blood pressure
14. History of stroke
15. Severe asthma
16. Hyperthyroidism
17. Narrow-angle glaucoma
18. Symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia or bladder neck obstruction
19. Clinically significant electrocardiographic abnormality, including a QTc ≥ 450 ms in men or ≥ 470 ms in women, a history of torsades de pointes or significant ventricular arrhythmia, second- or third-degree atrioventricular block without a pacemaker, or any other ECG abnormality considered clinically significant by the investigator
20. Taking inhibitors of UGT1A9, UGT1A10, ALDH, and ADH
21. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
22. Current protective measure (guardianship and judicial protection)
23. Participation in another interventional research trial involving another psychotherapeutic or pharmacological intervention that may affect the clinical course
24. Current or past psychotic or bipolar disorder
25. Other unstabilised psychiatric disorder
26. Family history (first-degree relatives) of psychotic disorder or bipolar disorder type 1
